description: Deep supervision with auxiliary losses at multiple levels: conv1→relu1 output feeds conv2 AND loss1 (side supervision); conv2→relu2 output feeds conv3 AND loss2; conv3→loss3. Three splits total: (1) label feeding all 3 losses; (2) conv1_out after relu1 (2 consumers); (3) conv2_out after relu2 (2 consumers). Tests MULTIPLE independent split points along a linear chain and correct bottom rewriting for auxiliary loss layers.
